description: Extracts hardcoded UI strings into translation keys, rewrites the code to call the i18n library (setting it up when missing), and translates the new messages into every target language. Follows localize.config.json. Writes files unless dry_run; review the diff afterwards. Needs a localize.dev API key.

app.description: Monorepo: the app to work in (e.g. apps/web), relative to the repository root. Default: the root.

changed.description: Only the files changed since the last commit (staged or not, and new ones), instead of paths.

dir.description: Source folder to scan, relative to the app (default: localize.config.json, else the framework's own).

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing files.

paths.description: Only these files or globs, relative to the source folder (e.g. ["components/Cart.tsx"]). Pass the files you just changed, so a run stays quick.

name: localize
title: Localize hardcoded text
